newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: BANK NEGARA DENIES RUMOURS OF MANAGEMENT CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: BANK NEGARA DENIES RUMOURS OF MANAGEMENT CHANGE.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia on Friday denied rumours of any change in its senior management, the national Bernama news agency reported.
"There is no such thing," a spokeswoman for Bank Negara was quoted as saying in response to Bernama's questions.
Bernama said the rumours originated from Singapore.
On Thursday, Bank Negara had also denied rumours that its Governor Ahmad Mohamed Don had resigned.
The rumours follow a sharp slide in the ringgit over the last one month under a speculative attack.
Many measures including intervention and limited capital controls have failed to halt the ringgit's fall.
Bank Negara's foreign exchange reserves have declined by nearly 10 billion ringgit in the last one month due to its intervention activities.
